instruction: Break the simplified text into atomic facts, one per line in human_atoms. An atomic fact is a short sentence that states one piece of information. Cover every sentence of the response, including claims that look wrong or off topic; skip only text that states nothing (a question, a greeting, a fragment). Do not check whether a fact is true or supported: this is about what the response says, not whether it is right.
